title: docs(skills): roll-up guidance resolves security-rollup-source-unreadable before finishing
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9LJtbpcpkE1YhBy5uWLi6Ra)_
Fixes #33819

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:数据技能的「汇总字段」一节新增一段教学 + 一个示例 + 一条评测用例:搭建时若出现 `security-rollup-source-unreadable` 警告,必须处理掉再收尾——该权限集应看子记录就授予读取,不应看就在该集上屏蔽父对象的汇总字段。
- 为什么改:按裁决「改为搭建侧处理」;评测发现 15 次 project+task 搭建全部带着这条警告收尾,不该看任务的客户仍能从项目上的任务数看到汇总。
- 风险与回滚:仅文档与评测,不改运行时;回滚即 revert 本 PR。relationships.md 的 token 天花板 4127→4232(先削两处重复,余额按实测提高)。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`(新增段落与示例)→ `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`(天花板行与算式)→ 评测 JSON 第 20 条。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期 relationships.md 显示 4232 / 4232、全部通过。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` § Roll-up Summaries: a new paragraph "Never finish with `security-rollup-source-unreadable` standing." It says when the warning fires (a set reads the summary but not the child object, the aggregated field, or a field the roll-up's `filter` tests), and the per-set decision: should see the children ⇒ grant the read; should not ⇒ mask the summary on that set (`fields["PARENT.SUMMARY"]: { readable: false }`), after removing any View All / Modify All the set holds on the parent, since either overrides the mask (measured below, control leg C). One worked `definePermissionSet` fragment (`client_viewer`, `project` read, `'project.task_count': { readable: false }`).
- Paid down first in the same section (239 bytes), each rule keeping a home: the `procurement_receipt` / `received_amount` filtered-sum example (the section's code block shows `function: 'sum'` beside `filter: { status: 'received' }`; the three-counts sentence carries "one child, several totals"), and the "a child moving in or out of the predicate recomputes the parent" sentence (the section's opening already says the parent recomputes on every child insert/update/delete).
- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`: case 20 — a `client_viewer` set that reads `project` but must never read `task`, a `project.task_count` count roll-up. `must_contain` the count and the mask spelling; `must_not_contain` only the `task` read grant (`task: { allowRead: true }`), the one shape a correct answer never writes (review round 1: "safe to ignore" and `viewAllRecords: true` were dropped, since a correct answer can contain either while naming what to avoid).
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the `relationships.md` row 4127 → 4232, pinned at the measurement (arithmetic in the row comment). Raise path is the standing ruling, verbatim: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (ruling record 6513306068).
- `.changeset/33819-rollup-source-unreadable-skill.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.
- No forced test edits. `rules/security.md` and `rules/field-types.md` untouched.

## Tests

The worked example was run through the real rule (`runAuthoringRules('build', …)` from `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`, on a stack built with `ObjectSchema.create` / `definePermissionSet` / `defineStack`; the example body passed to `definePermissionSet` exactly as shipped). Command: `cd packages/lint && npx tsx proof-shipped.mts` (scratch script, not committed), exit 0.

<details><summary>Proof output — before: 1 warning · after: 0 · grant alternative: 0 · View All control: 1</summary>

```text
--- BEFORE shipped example without the fields line => 1 finding(s)
   warning security-rollup-source-unreadable | permission set "client_viewer" · summary field "project.task_count" | "project.task_count" counts "task" records, and permission set "client_viewer" cannot read object "task"; a roll-up aggregates the whole child collection and follows only the parent field's own permissions
--- AFTER shipped example verbatim => 0 finding(s)
--- ALT grant instead of mask => 0 finding(s)
--- CONTROL mask + viewAllRecords on project => 1 finding(s)
   warning security-rollup-source-unreadable | permission set "client_viewer" · summary field "project.task_count" | ... | hint: If its value should not be visible to this set, first remove View All and Modify All on "project" from it, since fields["project.task_count"]: { readable: false } does not hide a field from a set holding either, then set ...
```

The same boundary held with `modifyAllRecords: true` on `project` (1 warning) in the seat-side measurement on `origin/main` 895783a1.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Seat hypothesis ① (View All / Modify All on the parent defeats the mask) is CONFIRMED by measurement and taught ("after removing any View All / Modify All it holds on the parent").
- Hypothesis ② — the sibling `security-rollup-source-row-scoped` (info) is NOT taught: advisory, the pairing is often intended, and the card's "Done when" names only the warning. Left as an open question in the report.
- Hypothesis ③ — one home, `rules/relationships.md` (read at roll-up time). No pointer in `rules/security.md` (zero token headroom there); open question in the report.
- The example is an unmarked fragment, so `check:skill-examples` does not compile it; its correctness evidence is the proof run above.
- Authoring arrangement: this thread is served below the card's mandated tier, so the `skills/**` text was authored by an at-tier (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`) subagent in the same worktree and branch; gates, relay writes and the report stay with the thread.

Local gate union re-run in full at head `099fa84`, the review round 1 fix; the first run at `02b5f1c` read the same (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, every listed command run, exit captured before any pipe):

- 63 derived · 62 exit 0 · 1 NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (reads every package's `dist/`; this worktree built only the lint and client closures). Declared narrowing; CI carries it.
- `--ran` reconciliation (exit codes recorded): "63 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 62 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".
- Acceptance gates, each exit 0 at `099fa84`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-docs` ("Skill docs in sync"), `check:skill-refs` ("9 generated files in sync"), `check:skill-examples` ("346 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)", after building the client closures it reads), `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (and `--self-test`), `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `git diff --check`.
